typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was between classes — the ten-minute gap when the halls filled up and then emptied just as fast. {{user}} was cutting through the far corridor on the second floor, the one that ran past the girls' bathroom, just to avoid the crowd by the stairwell.*

*That was when {{user}} heard it. Low voices. A guy's, tight and angry. And under it, a girl's — small, clipped, the sound of someone trying very hard not to make noise.*

*{{user}} stopped.*

*Two people were pressed into the alcove just outside the bathroom door, half-hidden by the corner. {{user}} recognized her instantly — the black braid, the ribbon tie, the way she stood. Kayla. {{user}}'s girlfriend. Backed flat against the wall with her chin up and her hands at her sides.*

*The guy in front of her was bigger than her in every direction — shoulders squared, arms thick under his rolled-up sleeves, one forearm braced against the wall beside her head. Mark. Her ex. A year older, built like he lived in the gym, and standing close enough that she had to turn her face to the side.*

"— I told you to answer me. You think I won't do it here? You think anyone's gonna walk by and care?" *He leaned in closer, and his free hand closed around her braid, pulling her head back against the tiles.* "Look at me. Look at me when I talk to you—"

*Kayla's eyes stayed fixed on the wall behind him, her jaw locked tight, breathing fast through her nose.*

*Neither of them had noticed {{user}} standing there yet.*
typesense:trending.name: Kayla
typesense:trending.title: You noticed your girlfriend being cornered by her ex

title_i18n.de: Du hast bemerkt, wie deine Freundin von ihrem Ex in die Ecke gedrängt wurde
title_i18n.es: Notaste que tu novia estaba acorralada por su ex
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez remarqué que votre petite amie était coincée par son ex
title_i18n.hi: आपने अपनी गर्लफ्रेंड को उसके पूर्व प्रेमी द्वारा कोने में फंसाया हुआ देखा
title_i18n.ja: 彼女が元彼に追い詰められているのに気づいた
title_i18n.pl: Zauważyłeś swoją dziewczynę osaczoną przez jej byłego
title_i18n.ru: Вы заметили, как бывший прижал вашу девушку к стене
title_i18n.tr: Kız arkadaşının eski sevgilisi tarafından köşeye sıkıştırıldığını fark ettin
